name: Tempreon
description:
Tempreon is a personal AI operating system: a person-owned intelligence layer that captures how you think, decide, write, and work — your identity, knowledge, preferences, decision rules, guardrails, and accumulated lessons.

It's more than memory. Memory recalls what you said; Tempreon learns what you meant and how you decide. Every session generates observations, patterns are tested against real outcomes, and what holds up gets promoted into validated instincts that shape future work. Your AI doesn't just remember more — it gets better at being yours.

Connected to Claude, every conversation starts with continuity and judgment. Claude knows who you are and what you're working on, searches your personal knowledge and File Vault, manages your tasks, and can dispatch your trained agents — named specialists that carry your voice — for autonomous, audit-trailed work. And the drafts, outreach, and replies you write together hold your voice — cadence, vocabulary, non-negotiables — so the result reads like you, not a template.

Because the layer is person-owned, it's portable: the same identity, learning, and guardrails travel with you across engines and tools. Your context isn't locked inside any one assistant. It's yours, applied wherever you work.

Scoped to you alone: your data is isolated to your account, never sold or shared, and writes happen only on your explicit action.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tempreon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tempreon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.tempreon.com/functions/v1/tempreon-mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tempreon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tempreon lists 15 MCP tools, including agent, create_agent, dispatch_agent, get_file, log_feedback, log_work, manage_task, personalize, remember, remove_file, save_file, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tempreon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tempreon in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Tempreon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tempreon is developed by Tempreon. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
